title: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Is a Superhero Movie for Yearners
summary: Sadie Sink’s character brings a great deal to the movie’s emotional tenor. The way her character works alongside Holland’s Peter, and the way their emotional arcs echo and answer one another, is one of the film’s great strengths.
